name: Elemental War

angles.text: As a shaman, you witness primal forces clash as Neptulon’s servants fight the fire elementals.
As a member of the Horde, you can aid the elemental fight while passing through Stonetalon Mountains. Tsunaman is stationed at Sun Rock Retreat.

faq.answer: Tsunaman is an envoy of the Tribunal of the Tides at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. Under Neptulon the Tidehunter’s authority, he wages war on fire elementals and sends you to destroy them.
Neptulon the Tidehunter bears an ancient enmity toward fire elementals and seeks their destruction. The Tribunal of the Tides sent Tsunaman to carry out this campaign in Stonetalon Mountains.
faq.q: Why does Neptulon want the fire elementals destroyed?

faq.answer: The Charred Vale lies in southern Stonetalon Mountains. Fiery elementals and other dangerous beasts born of flame and ruin overrun its ash-covered basin.
faq.q: Where is the Charred Vale located?

faq.answer: Incendrites are burning remnants left when the fire elementals of the Charred Vale are destroyed. Tsunaman gathers these cores as proof of their destruction and to win favor with the Tribunal of the Tides.

The Tribunal of the Tides is an authority among water elementals that serves Neptulon the Tidehunter. It directs elemental forces and envoys such as Tsunaman to carry out the Tidehunter’s will against rival elemental domains.
faq.q: What is the Tribunal of the Tides?

faq.answer: Neptulon the Tidehunter is the Elemental Lord of water and ruler of the oceans, seas, and all water elementals. Like the other elemental lords, he wages an ancient, unending conflict against rival elements, especially fire.

sections.body: At Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains, Tsunaman speaks for the Tribunal of the Tides. You carry out Neptulon the Tidehunter’s will against the fiery kin of his water elementals. Their enmity reaches far beyond mortal borders. It is an ancient struggle between the primal forces of Azeroth.
sections.title: Primal Rivalry in the Mountains

sections.body: Southern Stonetalon Mountains hold the Charred Vale, where ash and smoke mark the land. Fire elementals gather there and threaten the surrounding regions. Tsunaman sends you to destroy them and gather the Incendrites they leave behind. These blazing cores prove to the Tribunal that the elementals are gone.
sections.title: The Ash and the Flame

summary: In Stonetalon Mountains, Tsunaman sends you against fire elementals in Neptulon’s name. The water envoy at Sun Rock Retreat asks you to enter the Charred Vale and gather Incendrite cores from the blazing elementals you destroy. Their struggle reaches beyond mortal borders, bound to the ancient rivalry between elemental forces.
